name: LValueData.fitsParams_auxPair
summary: Check the four fields of FitsParams: the parameters correspond (gap of paramV and a decreasing position), and the order and column conditions, by computation of paramV for the one-row weight of X.

steps.claim: The correspondence of parameters at each infinite place w: the gap of paramV(auxPair(X)) (`AuxPair.isHCParam_paramV`), and the matching of the decreasing positions (`IsHCParam.exists_decrPosition_eq`, |n| > 1); the remaining fields (order, columns) by unfolding paramV, hcParameter and the diagram weight.
steps.lean:
refine' .mk (fun w ↦ ⟨X.auxPair.isHCParam_paramV.hasGap .., .mk .., _, fun _ ↦
    .inl ((X.auxPair.isHCParam_paramV.exists_decrPosition_eq w X.one_lt_card.le).imp
    _)⟩) .. <;> simp [AuxPair.paramV, hcParameter, diagramWeight_apply, AuxPair.detExp,
    IsMatchedPair, pairSign, Function.Injective] <;> grind [X.one_lt_card]
